profile.headline: SWE @ Microsoft
profile.summary: I am a computer engineer, passionate leader and eager learner (the type that can spend hours talking about a book or documentary). I am an idealist, and strongly believe that I can use my passion for technology and coding to improve the world around me. To take care of others and to take care of our environment is my definition of success. I firmly believe that failure is just a driver for improvement and that collaboration is what makes us great! Challenging yourself even if it does not work out, will always lead to improvement.

positions.title: Operations Intern
positions.description: As part of the Product Development team, I worked on launching and testing features for Payments and Regulations in the Didi Driver and Rides App. Worked with the HQ team to test new app features in Mexico and select the ones that generated most impact by creating dashboards with data collection and analysis (Python & SQL), to finally select the optimal features for implementation. I was also a part of the development and launch of special feature projects like "Didi Vacúnate" and "Didi Hero" both business efforts in response to Covid. Collaborated closely with other areas of the organization as the bridge between developers and business-side.

positions.title: Ambassador
positions.description: Selected by a committee to represent the University as a student leader in seminars, conferences and public events. Talked to large audiences about my experience and received training on public speaking and communication skills. Worked closely with the school's directors and faculty to create better exposure for the school.
